transport: JSON over loopback HTTP; all API endpoints require Authorization: Bearer <in-memory local auth>

spec.endpoint: isolated loopback HTTP /v1 or explicit HTTPS /v1; remote execution defaults disabled; operator stdin allow_remote:true required
spec.timeout: wall-clock seconds .05..5, worker terminated at deadline
spec.token_budget: integer 1..100000; byte-based conservative reservation and reported usage both bounded
spec.conditions: use capabilities.conditions[protocol] exactly; supported temperature 0..1 or null
spec.source: calibration provenance established independently; synthetic: description for synthetic samples

baseline_import.samples: 40..10000 integers 1..355; probe statistics, never chat text

limitations: Default remote execution disabled, only synthetic execution verified. HTTPS supported after explicit operator credential/cost authorization. At least 40 valid samples and two compatible reference models required. Complete JSON only; no SSE authentication or per-request identity certification.
